displayName.description: Display name for the file. Trimmed; empty or null clears it

altText.description: Description of the image in the language of the file (the `alt` attribute on the web). Trimmed; empty or null clears it

version.description: The `version` of the record the change is based on (from its detail). When another one is stored, nothing is written and the answer is 409 with the code VERSION_CONFLICT. Left out, the change is written without the check
